coaching.headline: The duo lane won this: Sparrow and Adele died six times there, against three allied deaths across the whole map.

flags.text: Skylar did the damn damage: 7480 to heroes, the game's most, plus first blood on Adele.
Khaimera finished with zero deaths, took the Seedling, and killed Sparrow one second after Sparrow killed Steel.
Lt. Belica died to Gideon on mid outside any detected fight; Wukong took Mini Prime within a minute.
Wukong took Mini Prime and dealt 3830 objective damage; allies managed zero, a shit return on ten kills.

focus.title: Turn duo kills into towers
focus.action: After every pick on Sparrow or Adele, the alive allies hit the nearest duo-lane tower before resetting; before Mini Prime, the midlaner and jungler move to the pit together.

3.9.call: An even trade on the duo lane: Skylar killed Sparrow, then Adele killed Skylar in the allied half; the duo lane still finished well ahead on kills.

7.6.call: Two separate plays: Greystone killed Gideon on mid, then Steel fell on the duo lane and Khaimera and Lt. Belica killed Sparrow and Adele, a two-for-one in the Seedling window.

10.1.call: Wukong took Mini Prime first; Skylar and Khaimera then killed Sparrow and Adele on the duo lane with no allied death, a clean two-for-zero after the Prime was gone.

a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Two kills on Sparrow and one death, to Adele moments after the first. After killing Sparrow with Adele alive, step back toward Steel before the next trade.
Farm sat at 6.5 CS per minute against an own average of 9.1. When no fight is live, clear every duo-lane wave first; Vanquisher and Imperator need that gold.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Zero deaths with three kills and four assists, the best kill participation on the team. Whenever Sparrow or Adele drops low on the duo lane, gank there first.
Wukong took 40 camp minions from the allied jungle while only 10 came out of the enemy jungle the other way. Before the next invade, ward the allied jungle entrances.
a15e1fea-65e6-4893-a788-135f021d58d8: Kills on Gideon on mid, Wukong in the enemy jungle, and Adele on the duo lane after Steel fell. Repeat that rotation whenever the duo lane trades.
Hero damage ran 373 per minute against an own average of 905. Once Combustion is done, open trades on Gideon with the Seismic Assault stun.
The death to Gideon landed in the allied half of mid, outside any detected fight. When a Prime is due, trade on mid only with the jungler close.
8b582daf-6779-4c3f-ba4a-453826d9c286: Zero deaths and the game's highest level, with CS at 10.6 per minute over an own average of 9.6. Keep that farm rate whenever the offlane stays quiet.
One kill, on Gideon at mid, and zero assists: a hand in one of ten allied kills. When the duo lane fights and the offlane wave is pushed, rotate down.
104edae6-307f-4fac-b922-4a50b05ce123: Three wards against an own average of 8.9, the same count as Adele. Before any Mini Prime, spend a ward on the pit approach.
Kill participation of 30% and 4717 damage mitigated; the death to Sparrow was answered by kills on Sparrow and Adele. Take duo-lane fights only when the jungler is close.

matchup: Shinbi was the lane opponent; the field gives this offlane a 51.4% record into Shinbi over 752 games.
Took 2686 magical hero damage against 1717 physical; the crest path carries more physical armor than magical.
build: Overlord, the one finished item, belongs to the best offlane core alongside Rapture and Forticus.
Overlord splashes basic-attack damage around the target, and hero kills grant permanent health.
eternal: Krix adds maximum health that grows per level; Voracity heals on unit kills, Cannibalism adds health on takedowns.
Nihil and Weald lead a toss-up in this offlane field; Krix ranks third, but Voracity with Cannibalism is the best Krix pair.
augment: Close Cut raises Make Way damage against the nearest enemy unit.
Tainted Oath and Imperial Soul lead a toss-up in this offlane field; Close Cut, the most played, ranks third.
crest: The Saphir's Mantle active grows size and max health briefly, damages nearby heroes, then keeps a share as permanent health.
Pacifier and Eviscerator lead a toss-up in this offlane field but start from a different base crest. Sound keep.
improvement: The field buys Tainted Bastion more into Shinbi, at a 53.1% win rate: the one matchup swap on record.
Rapture and Forticus complete the best offlane core with Overlord, a 65.8% win rate over 158 games.
Tainted Oath over Close Cut is the field-backed augment swap: Sacred Oath applies Blight instead of extra Make Way damage.

matchup: The duo faced Sparrow and Adele; the field gives this carry a 49.4% record into Sparrow over 1010 games.
Sparrow took 70 lane minions to 64, so the duo-lane kills came without a farm lead.
Took 1128 damage from heroes, the least of all ten players.
build: Plasma Blade, the one finished item, opens the most played core into Sparrow, ahead of Vanquisher and Imperator.
Plasma Blade stacks extra critical strike chance briefly on basic attacks against heroes.
eternal: Weald fires true-damage missiles after damaging a low-health hero; Forage adds gold and XP on minion and monster kills.
Thraex, Weald and Xyris are a toss-up in this carry field; Forage with Wind-Rider is the best Weald pair. Sound keep.
augment: Assault MK-II makes Air Assault hover longer and fire an extra missile with each attack.
Assault MK-II and Plasma Barrage are a toss-up in this carry field, with Assault MK-II first. Sound keep.
crest: Still on Sharpshooter Crest, which evolves after restoring enough health from basic attacks and kills.
Pacifier is clearly the best crest in this carry field and evolves from Sharpshooter Crest.
improvement: The most played core into Sparrow, Plasma Blade then Vanquisher and Imperator, wins 50.5% over 93 games; finish that path.
When the crest evolves, take Pacifier: a dash that empowers the next physical hit, much stronger on low-health targets.

matchup: Wukong was the jungle opponent; the field gives this jungler a 55.1% record into Wukong over 524 games.
Ganks paid on the duo lane, with kills on Sparrow and Adele there, plus Gideon on mid.
build: Overlord was the one finished item, outside the best jungle core of Malady, Terminus and Necrosis.
Overlord cleaves on every basic attack, which speeds camp clears and reaches grouped heroes.
eternal: Knell shreds hero armor with Rust stacks; Frequency adds attack speed and haste per stack, Peal adds ultimate haste.
Lotus leans first in this jungle field over Knell; Frequency with Resonant Repair is the best Knell pair.
augment: Jungle Invasion adds physical power in any jungle, doubled in the enemy jungle.
Jungle Invasion is clearly the best augment in this jungle field. Sound keep.
crest: Still on Champion Crest, which heals on hero and monster damage and evolves after enough healing.
Pacifier and Gravitum lead a toss-up in this jungle field; Gravitum evolves from Champion Crest, Pacifier does not.
improvement: The best jungle core is Malady, Terminus and Necrosis, a 62.6% win rate over 310 games; that path replaces Overlord.
When the crest evolves, Gravitum stays on the Champion path and grounds the first hero hit by a long-range shot.

matchup: Gideon was the lane opponent; the field gives this midlaner a 52.8% record into Gideon over 787 games.
Took 3545 magical hero damage out of 4433, so magical armor answers the main pressure.
build: Combustion, the one finished item, starts both the best mid core and the most played core into Gideon.
Combustion bursts nearby enemies on ability damage, and damaging heroes shortens that burst cooldown.
eternal: Vesh turns a share of ability damage on heroes into damage over time; Mind Rot adds current-health damage.
Lotus leans first in this mid field and Vesh ranks well behind; The Tenth Seal with Millennia is the best Vesh pair.
augment: Devastating Bombs makes Void Bomb hit isolated targets harder.
Combat Veteran is clearly the best augment in this mid field; Devastating Bombs, the most played, ranks third.
crest: Still on Wizard Crest, which restores mana on ability hits and evolves after enough mana restored.
Soulbearer leans first in this mid field and evolves from Wizard Crest: a shield plus magical lifesteal on the active.
improvement: The best mid core adds Wraith Leggings and Oblivion Crown to Combustion, a 57.9% win rate over 240 games.
Combat Veteran over Devastating Bombs is the field-backed swap: movement speed and passive experience instead of isolated-target Void Bomb damage.

matchup: The duo faced Sparrow and Adele; the field gives this support a 52.3% record into Adele over 1100 games.
Adele roots with Imperial Lash and mesmerizes with Royal Flourish, the enemy duo's main crowd control.
build: No item finished on 2767 gold, the lowest of all ten, so the game never tested the build.
eternal: Krix scales maximum health by level; Regenerative Tissue regenerates health out of hero combat, Cannibalism adds health on takedowns.
Knell leans first in this support field; Krix, the most played, ranks behind; Regenerative Tissue with Cannibalism is the best Krix pair.
augment: Colossal Crash enlarges Shield Slam range and area and makes the impact knock enemies back instead.
Heavy Metal and Adaptive Force lead a toss-up in this support field; Colossal Crash ranks behind both.
crest: Still on Goliath Crest: physical and magical armor plus healing on taking damage, evolving after enough healing.
Leafsong leans first in this support field but evolves from Warden Crest; Saphir's Mantle has the most Goliath-path games.
improvement: The best support core is Fire Blossom, Forticus and Tainted Guard, a 63.9% win rate over 155 games.
Heavy Metal over Colossal Crash is the field-backed swap: bonus magical damage from armor, giving up the wider Shield Slam knockback.

threats: Dive threat on our backline: Shinbi. Assign peel for the carry and ward the flanks.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Assault The Gates leap in, Make Way to shred armor, Sacred Oath empowered cleave to slow, then Stone Forged Soul to heal in Stasis and crash down.
ourKits.winCondition: Stay in the middle of fights and use Stone Forged Soul's missing-health heal to reset, while Make Way shreds armor for the team.
ourKits.passive: Stoicism deflects the next basic attack on a cooldown and grants health regen and armor that grow as he loses health.
ourKits.playWith: Damage dealers who can follow his leap and benefit from Make Way's armor shred.
ourKits.playAgainst: Do not burst into Stone Forged Soul's Stasis; step away from the slow and the crash, then re-engage. Open with an ability since Stoicism deflects a basic, and buy anti-heal to cut the ult heal.

ourKits.combo: Plasma Grenade slow → Air Assault to hover with extra range → Hypercharge burst → Atomiser to finish a low target
ourKits.winCondition: hover with Air Assault for extra basic range and shred with Hypercharge, refreshing it on takedowns
ourKits.passive: extra jump height; kills make the target explode, much larger from enemy heroes
ourKits.playWith: a frontline that holds enemies in place while she hovers and fires
ourKits.playAgainst: Air Assault is her only reposition, so engage after it ends and she is back on the ground; dodge Plasma Grenade's slow and sidestep the Atomiser channel, which stops on the first hero hit

ourKits.combo: Ambush leap and slow, Unleash for maximum attack speed cleaving basics, Cull to lock the target, Invigorate to cleanse and heal.
ourKits.winCondition: Stick to one target, build Rage for regen and faster cooldowns, and out-sustain them in long fights.
ourKits.passive: Ancestral Fury builds Rage on hits, giving health regen and faster cooldowns, plus movement speed at high Rage.
ourKits.playAgainst: Buy anti-heal to cut Invigorate and Rage regen. Save your CC until after Invigorate is used since it cleanses, and break off for a few seconds so his Rage decays.

ourKits.combo: Void Drone for vision and mana drain, Seismic Assault to knock up and stun, Void Bomb, then Neural Disruptor to silence and finish.
ourKits.winCondition: Drain mana with Void Drone and land Seismic Assault, then burst with Neural Disruptor's missing-mana damage.
ourKits.passive: Innovation upgrades each ability at max rank and grants ability haste.
ourKits.playWith: Follow-up damage during Seismic Assault's knockup and stun.
ourKits.playAgainst: Seismic Assault erupts after a short delay, so sidestep the line. Avoid casting near Void Drone since it zaps and drains mana, and dive her after Seismic Assault is used; magical armor helps.

ourKits.combo: Bull Rush in unstoppable to knock back → Shield Bash stun → Shield Slam knockup and stun, Force Shield to block projectiles
ourKits.winCondition: engage with Shield Slam or Bull Rush and protect carries with Force Shield's projectile wall
ourKits.passive: a self-shield that lasts until broken and refreshes when out of damage, plus hybrid armor
ourKits.playWith: ranged carries he can shield from enemy projectiles, and follow-up damage for his engages
ourKits.playAgainst: Bull Rush is unstoppable, so do not waste CC into it; walk around Force Shield instead of shooting into it, and fight after Shield Slam is on cooldown

enemyKits.combo: Imperial Lash roots and dashes her to the furthest hero hit, Royal Flourish spins to Mesmerize, then Queen's Garden leaps in to root and drop a slowing Thornbush, with Iron Rose cast mid-combo for damage reduction
enemyKits.winCondition: start fights with Lash or Queen's Garden and keep enemies stuck in the Thornbush while her Thorns make allies hit harder
enemyKits.passive: damaging enemy heroes applies Thorns, and allies deal bonus true damage to Thorned enemies
enemyKits.playWith: damage dealers who follow her engage and profit from Thorns bonus true damage
enemyKits.playAgainst: sidestep Imperial Lash, since without it she has to walk in; once Queen's Garden is down she has no big lockdown, and walking out of the Thornbush limits its damage and slow; tenacity helps against her chained root and Mesmerize

enemyKits.combo: Pole Vault leap in (Body) → High Impact slam slow → switch stance → Cyclebreaker spin and stun throw → Windsurge dash
enemyKits.winCondition: swap stances for the right tool and keep damaging enemies to spawn clones that add pressure
enemyKits.passive: Somersault lets him double jump into the air
enemyKits.playWith: teammates who fight alongside his clones and follow up on his stun
enemyKits.playAgainst: AoE clears his clones; avoid the Cyclebreaker throw stun, and wait out its damage-reduction spin before bursting him

enemyKits.combo: Rushing Beat dashes through the target → Line Tempo wolf → Circle Rhythm for shield and speed → All-Kill! once Track is maxed
enemyKits.winCondition: hit heroes with abilities to max Track, then cast All-Kill! to drop a wolf pack on every hero she recently damaged
enemyKits.passive: Biting Melody adds magical damage on-hit; every few seconds an empowered basic applies Track and restores mana
enemyKits.playWith: teammates who engage or slow so she can dash in and land every ability for Track
enemyKits.playAgainst: All-Kill! only works once she has stacked Track, so do not trade abilities with her for free; fight after Rushing Beat charges are spent, burst through Circle Rhythm's shield, and buy magical armor if she gets ahead

enemyKits.combo: Void Breach slows, the empowered basic attaches a Cosmic Tether that roots, Cosmic Rift lands on the rooted target, then Black Hole drags the group together
enemyKits.winCondition: land Black Hole and Cosmic Rift on a clumped team for area burst
enemyKits.passive: hitting a hero with an ability empowers his next basic attack to tether the target, dealing damage then rooting them
enemyKits.playWith: hard engage that clumps enemies into his Black Hole
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Void Breach and Cosmic Rift; Torn Space is his only escape, so dive him after it is used; walk out of Black Hole early since it drags slowly; magic armor blunts his burst

enemyKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses for attack speed → Hail of Arrows slow → Inner Fire barrage
enemyKits.winCondition: stack Relentless with basics and abilities to add max-health damage and melt the frontline in long fights
enemyKits.passive: Relentless stacks on hit and makes her basics deal bonus max-health damage
enemyKits.playWith: peel and a frontline, since her only escape is a short stealth
enemyKits.playAgainst: Heightened Senses is her only escape, a brief stealth with speed and no dash, so hard-engage her after it is used; Piercing Shot passes through terrain, so do not hide behind walls at low health
